name: The Yoo Cube Deluxe II 3x3
description: The Yoo Cube Deluxe II is the ultimate Yoo Cube! This is the successor to the first generation Yoo Cube Deluxe. While testing prototype setups for this cube, CubeHead broke not only all of his PB's at home but also the Belgian National Record at the New York Yopen 2022. He got an amazing time of 5.88s!
features: Piece Lubes: Weight 5, Angstrom Dignitas, Cubicle Labs Mystic, DNM-37
